# PATIENTS UNDERGOING PROCEDURES THAT INVOLVE INFECTED SKIN, SKIN STRUCTURES, OR INFECTED MUSCULOSKELETAL TISSUE
A patient with an infection involving skin, skin structures, or infected musculoskeletal tissue may need antimicrobial for treatment of this infection (links provided below). If so, the antimicrobial may also reduce the risk of endocarditis in a person with a high risk cardiac lesion. Under these circumstances, ensure that antimicrobial concentrations in tissues are therapeutic for the duration of the procedure. If the patient is not receiving systemic antimicrobial therapy for treatment of the infection, consider giving one dose of an antimicrobial listed below for prevention of endocarditis in a person with a high risk cardiac lesion.
